description: This file defines an internal interface 'IClusterConnectionStatusListener' in the Orleans namespace, which provides callback methods for notifying about cluster connection status changes, such as gateway count changes and connection losses.

classes.name: IClusterConnectionStatusListener
classes.description: Interface for notifying observers that connection to the cluster has been lost.

methods.name: NotifyGatewayCountChanged
methods.description: Notifies this client that the number of connected gateways has changed.

methods.name: NotifyClusterConnectionLost
methods.description: Notifies this client that the connection to the cluster has been lost.
